title: Finite local unit lifts at an affine open stage
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], J a small cofiltered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and D:J→X_et a diagram of etale objects [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] whose terms are affine [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and whose structure maps to X are open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let c be a limiting cone of the underlying scheme diagram and p:c.pt→X satisfy c.π_j followed by D(j).hom = p for every j. Let H be a left adjoint to p_* with specified adjunction hH [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], F an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and t a section of H(F) on the terminal etale object T=(c.pt,id). Write p* for actual base change [def-pc-fibre-product] and η for the specified adjunction unit. Then there are a stage j, a finite possibly empty set B, affine etale X-objects V_b, arrows v_b:V_b→D(j) forming a covering family, sections s_b in F(V_b), and arrows π_b:p*V_b→T forming a covering family, such that H(F)(π_b)(t)=η_F(V_b)(s_b) for every b. No compatibility of the s_b on overlaps is asserted.

source.place: Local inverse-image representing families in the proof, combined with 0EYL finite diagram and finite cover descent and 03Q6 proof steps (1)-(3)

proof.text: Obtain local unit representatives Z_i,z_i,W_i,a_i,s_i of t on the limit using the specified adjunction. No finite stage covering is chosen before these representatives.
Apply geometric representing-cover descent. Obtain j,B,r,V,v,w,e with two covering properties and p*(w_b)=e_b;a_{r(b)}.

Set s_b=F(w_b)(s_{r(b)}) and π_b=e_b;z_{r(b)}. Unit naturality for w_b identifies η(s_b) with H(F)(p*(w_b))(η(s_{r(b)})). Substitute the geometric arrow equality and use contravariant functoriality and the local representative equation to obtain H(F)(π_b)(t)=η(s_b). Assemble the witnesses, affineness, and the two covering properties. The Lean calculation proves this step completely, with no localization comparison or overlap agreement.

theorem affineOpenSections_inverse_image_finite_local_lifts
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} {J : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J]
    (D : J ⥤ X.Etale)
    [∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j).left] [∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (D.obj j).hom]
    (c : Cone (D ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X))
    (p : c.pt ⟶ X) (hp : ∀ j, c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = p)
    (hc : IsLimit c)
    (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤
      Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hH : H ⊣ p.Etale.sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology c.pt.smallEtaleTopology)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (t : (H.obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt)))) :
    ∃ (j : J) (B : Type (u + 1)) (_ : Finite B)
      (V : B → X.Etale) (v : ∀ b, V b ⟶ D.obj j)
      (s : ∀ b, F.obj.obj (op (V b)))
      (π : ∀ b, p.Etale.obj (V b) ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt)),
      (∀ b, IsAffine (V b).left) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows V v ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology (D.obj j) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows (fun b ↦ p.Etale.obj (V b)) π ∈
        c.pt.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt)) ∧
      ∀ b, (H.obj F).obj.map (π b).op t =
        (hH.unit.app F).hom.app (op (V b)) (s b)
